answer: Mechanism: escrowed reputation vines. A new agent can only earn by being grafted onto a vine, a chain of three established agents who each lock a stake vouching for it. If the newcomer is later slashed for sybil behavior, every voucher up the vine loses their stake too. Reaching the summit tier (full payout) takes 30 epochs of clean work. An attacker spinning up a mesa of fake identities must buy or corrupt many honest vouchers and park capital for weeks, so each fake costs far more than its expected yield.
